method: Read-only source and regression-contract review; no Cargo, inference, benchmark retry or label changes during this review. Only this versioned receipt and verbatim retained proof logs/driver were written.
scope: Latest fact-access write/read/ranking/decay/archival/observer integration. Earlier migration fencing and readiness/reconciliation changes were implemented by this same reviewer and are not claimed as independently authored review findings.

checks.basis: All seven typed channel vectors participate in the same overlay before build_ranked_context_facts and novelty_factor; existing channel collection performs access/kind filtering. Distinct exact-key batching is owned by read_fact_accesses. No gold/question-specific selection was introduced in this change.

Missing side rows become zero heat by explicit contract. Database/read-shape/deserialization/timestamp errors propagate instead of becoming a cold ranking. At most 64 distinct validated keys are bound per read query.

First access projects only persisted source_episode inside the transaction; subsequent accesses modify only side metadata. Both signed saturation branches guard addition; zero boost still stamps time. Bound values, namespace client enforcement, shared retry adapter and awaiting/four-wide cancellation ownership remain in place.

Every candidate ID and every side-stat batch are read/validated before the first retraction. Positive count plus recent timestamp preserves the prior protection predicate. Controlled read failure regression exists through the public decay seam.

Single and batched side-store queries use source_episode and inclusive recent timestamp without requiring positive count or valid fact. Worker obtains both active-fact and hot-episode sets before mutation; batched request size remains 64.
Revision-safe historical path bypasses current heat hydration and tracking. Other view semantics and existing synthetic-identity filtering remain unchanged.

Separate ignored upgrade action uses the explicitly supplied disposable store and performs migration outside the steady-read observer. Query observer and actual source/evidence capture do not inject missing evidence or relax reader labels. The caller remains responsible for supplying a disposable closed-store clone.

Examined lifecycle/explanation/service fixtures use actual side-store writes or side-store readback where heat behavior is tested; immutable fact assertions remain. Concurrency fixture exercises the public read seam and gates actual side-write SQL.

Inspected current native test, exact operator script, runbook and retained final 3/3 log. Verified bounded exact assignment/reconciliation, replay, offline handle closure, reopen and separate backup restoration; constraints and untested predecessor/remote boundaries are explicit.

limitations: Static review is not proof of correctness for all possible states.
This artifact does not qualify full-history completion, delivered evidence, reader correctness, latency improvement or C2 utility; those require the unchanged registered executions.
Exact source hashes define the reviewed snapshot; later edits require checking scope of drift.
Workspace lib/integration/clippy checks were still running under the root agent; no result is inferred here.

post_format_reinspection.result: No semantic drift identified on reinspection: seven-channel overlay remains before fusion; decay preloads all heat before mutation; side-table owner registration remains intact; upgrade/fault fixtures and observer keep the same contracts. Historical revision-safe route still deliberately omits mutable heat.
post_format_reinspection.comparison_limit: V1 pins digests, not full before-format file copies; this is source reinspection, not an automated proof that every byte difference is whitespace.
